verdict.rationale: An email provider could plausibly offer an AI-training opt-out or a no-training policy, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains no Fastmail documentation or policy on AI model training or opting out of it. One community comment that Fastmail is 'up front with how the data is handled' is generic and does not address AI training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
